verdict.rationale: The Amazon Chime SDK is a programmatic product: its documented capabilities (meetings, audio/video, screen share, data messages, messaging sessions) are all exposed through SDK APIs that client applications call. However, no evidence compares API coverage with any console or UI surface, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: documented API/console parity statement, published machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), coverage of admin/configuration operations via API, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Amazon Chime SDK is a set of real-time communications components that you can use to quickly add messaging, audio, video, and screen sharing capabilities to your web or mobile applications.
Create a meeting session in your client application.
Create a messaging session in your client application to receive messages from Amazon Chime SDK for Messaging.
